verdict.rationale: Pulumi supports a DIY state backend in object stores you control (S3, Azure Blob, GCS). Programs are written in standard open languages, and the platform is open source with self-hosting available. Together these imply you own your infrastructure definitions and state and can walk away. However, the evidence never documents an explicit export path out of Pulumi Cloud, an open state file format, or a migration procedure for leaving. Missing for 10: documented state/stack export from Pulumi Cloud, an open specification of the state format, a backend-migration or exit workflow, and independent corroboration of leaving.
